non_actions: No scoring, simulation, source image access or private pixels
No current homepage or prior dedicated page edits
No result JSON, phase freeze or deployment

dimensions.planned_deletion_scope: 2versions x3conditions x13fixed original physical leaves=78 rows; actual leaf IDs must come from frozen selection, not invented

source_ref.pointer: JSON Pointer or precise text span
source_ref.old_estimator_id: required when reusing original label_body or leaf_controls, never pooled

scalar.exact_value: {n:integer,d:positive_integer} or null; alternatively scaled_integer and inherited common denominator D
scalar.rule: No falsy-value default: zero is allowed only as an explicit mathematical result with its proper scope.

future_payload.phase: explicit frozen input allowlist, source bytes/hash and approval/review status
future_payload.historical_reuse: six frozen leaf_controls/run_v2 packages plus exact source/audit refs, all7models6increments/synchronized max/3conditions/group results; separate earlier label_body and exclusions
future_payload.A_null_size: per package/model/threshold exact rejection state count/total, >= tie convention, artificial uniform mechanism, Bonferroni bound separate from uncomputed actual joint error
future_payload.B_injection: all candidates including infeasible; all versions/seeds/K/conditions/models; event ledger, successful/no-legal-swap count, actual delta vsK0, invariant receipts and group results; summaries computed upstream, not client recomputation
future_payload.C_indistinguishability: same observable byte hash, source artificial output references, separate latent annotations without object truth; never two independently counted runs
future_payload.D_leave_one_leaf_out: all78 explicit scenarios, originalsupport and deletedleaf, labels row/body column removed, fixedlengths, allmodels/increments/ties/exacttail/range/group singleton information
future_payload.audit: exact scope: all78 deletion, allA+toy, allswap replay/invariants, prescribed sample of numerical B tails; comparator mismatches/failures retained
future_payload.interpretation: frozen Chinese conclusions, mechanism limits, weak-effect coverage gaps, semantics not identified
future_payload.history: old failures/exclusions, estimator definitions, method revisions and rejected versions preserved

B_row_contract.successful_swaps: integer or null, no assumed equality to K
B_row_contract.failed_attempts: actual ledger and reason; no resampling
B_row_contract.T_and_delta: exact upstream rationals plus source refs
B_row_contract.delta_change_from_K0: exact upstream contrast and percentage-point unit
B_row_contract.rejection: exact threshold rule/model; null for no valid output
B_row_contract.invariants: global andH/I/Q word frequencies, folio-length opportunity counts, all labels/repetition, sourceleaf/length/slot consistency; does not claim local body bags invariant

B_summary_contract.counts: reject / completed / infeasible / failed / all planned128 separately, no hidden successful-only denominator
B_summary_contract.clopper_pearson: 95 percent non-simultaneous interval for specified artificial seed mechanism only, upstream interval and method/version bound; not manuscript CI
B_summary_contract.K0: original manuscript background, no estimated false-positive rate
B_summary_contract.bin_rule: post-realization descriptive stratum, not power at a preselected effect parameter; uncovered bins explicitly empty, not zero sensitivity

D_row_contract.scope: all13 original leaves even if some scenarios no exchangeable group; no newly selected lengths
D_row_contract.singleton_math: Delta0/tail1 only if upstream exact singleton proof states this; never used as missing-data fill
D_row_contract.synchronized_max: NOT_COMPUTED if not supplied; not formed from six marginal tails
D_row_contract.interpretation: same exposed corpus sensitivity, not CI or independent replication

proposed_views: Outcome-first frozen summary with provenance, no temporary approval jargon once final
Historical and new artificial results clearly separated
Two-version comparison, three condition selectors, seven total-model rows and separate six-increment table
K-versus-achieved-effect panel with unsuccessful attempts and actual coverage bins
All78 deletion rows filterable without changing denominator, singleton label visible
Artificial identical-text witness with exact hash and distinct latent descriptions
All failures/exclusions, scope receipts and complete source/download manifests expandable
build_policy: No final payload before frozen contract and explicit real-data authorization.
Explicit source allowlist with SHA/bytes; no directory globs or implicit work-file discovery.
Client reads validated upstream results only; does not run scientific estimators or invent missing values.
JSON no-store plus content version query; large per-seed tables may be lazy chunks without dropping any row.
All output dependencies hashed; no private historical images or synthetic manuscript illustrations.
Local regression and exact public rebuild; actual browser/live acceptance belongs to root.
